titles.native: のびろのびろだいすきな木

description:
A creature takes care of a plant that rewards him in unexpected and wondrous ways. This tree grows throughout the seasons and sustains those around it until it comes full circle with its caretaker.

A Minna no Uta song by Ann Sally for the NHK Heart Exhibition.
